Mechanism claimed by the family (Crabel 1990; Holmberg, Lonnbark and Lundstrom 2013 FRL, crude oil; Zarattini and Aziz 2023 SSRN 4416622, 5-minute ORB on QQQ, +0.13R gross, no OOS): early-session order flow carrying overnight information continues after the first 30 minutes. rules: AS WRITTEN in ~/quant-edge-inherited/pr4/skills/prop-fleet/agents/daily/2026-10-06-0247/builder/prereg_orb30.txt (sha256 1e99c7752f176632bade8b36c5009c64bb8603ad73d5092346b4742f4d1950ea, stamped 2026-10-05T23:58:55Z, re-verified 2026-11-06), times America/New_York, applied per day with zoneinfo to HistData SPXUSD bars whose ts is bar-open UTC (clock histdata_rule; identical to the written NY clock for 2010-2018), one session d at a time using only bars of d up to the decision minute: (1) Eligibility at 10:00: d is a weekday, the 09:30 bar exists, and at least 25 of the 30 bars 09:30..09:59 exist. (2) ORH = max high, ORL = min low of bars 09:30..09:59; W = ORH - ORL. (3) Trigger: the first bar with time in 10:00..11:59 whose CLOSE is > ORH (long) or < ORL (short); only the first trigger counts; at most one trade per day. (4) Entry: open of the next existing bar after the trigger bar, provided that bar's time <= 12:00; otherwise no trade. (5) Stop: long ORL, short ORH; Risk = |entry - stop|; no trade if Risk < 1.0 pt or if the entry open is already at/beyond the stop. (6) Exit: from the entry bar inclusive, each bar: if the stop is touched, exit at the worse of the stop and that bar's open (stop-first on any ambiguous bar); otherwise exit at the close of the last existing bar at or before 15:59 (the 15:59 bar is not required). (7) Gross R = side*(exit-entry)/Risk; net R = gross R - cost/Risk (cost per cost_model). Variants, all three reported, none chosen afterwards: A = rules 1-7, no target; B = A plus target entry + side*2*Risk, a bar touching both stop and target counts as stop; C = A traded only if W < median W of the previous 20 eligible sessions (today excluded; needs 20). No news skip (as written; a +-2 min 10:00 ET news-skip version is reported as a no-count firm sensitivity).
parameters: range 09:30-09:59 ET; trigger window 10:00-11:59 on 1m closes; entry next bar open <= 12:00; stop opposite range edge; MIN_RISK 1.0 pt; exit last bar <= 15:59; B target 2R; C filter W < median of previous 20 eligible W
grid: A, B, C as written (3 variants, all reported; 3 counts)

cost_model: IS gate (as written): 0.6 pt round trip (tjr COST_PTS). OOS headline 1x for the FTMO US500 CFD per briefs/00-common.md (index CFDs 0.5-1.5 bp per side): the LARGER of the written 0.6 pt round trip and 1.0 bp of entry price per side (2.0 bp round trip; 0.6 pt at SPX 3,000, 1.2 pt at SPX 6,000), deducted as cost/Risk in R; no swap (flat intraday). 2x run attached (cost doubled). Venue sensitivity, no count: ES at 0.30 pt + $2.50 per side (00-common floors), same SPXUSD stream.
decision_rule: Two stages, both fixed now. STAGE 1 (as written, in-sample, IS window 2010-11-15..2018-12-31 = the written D1 2010-11..2018-12): report n, trades/yr, trades/day, gross and net mean R, day-level bootstrap p5 (10,000 draws, seed 0), net R by year, long vs short, median Risk in pt, exits by type, for A, B and C at the written 0.6 pt cost. The family earns the OOS read ONLY if variant A's D1 net bootstrap p5 > 0; B and C cannot rescue it. If A fails, the row is closed as 'refuted in-sample', no OOS read, and the family is closed: no other range lengths (5/15/60 min), entry windows, targets or filters. STAGE 2 (only if Stage 1 passes): Gate v2 on the OOS window 2019-01-02..2024-12-31, one read through qe.gateway.load(id,'oos'), each of A, B, C tested separately: pass iff (1) one-sided t of the net-1x per-trade R (day-clustered; stationary/day-cluster bootstrap >= 430,000 draws; the lower) >= 3.6807; (2) net-2x mean > 0; (3) criteria 4 and 7 of PARAMETERS.md (years, concentration, terciles, +-25% neighbours on the trigger-window end and MIN_RISK, one-bar delay) pass; (4) Red Team and re-implementation sign-off; (5) hold-out read on histdata_cfd_1m_SPXUSD_holdout in the restated one-sided tolerance form with h = decay_haircut. A pass of B or C alone with A failing is reported as a near-miss, never as the family's pass. Anything else is 'refuted' or 'near-miss' (t >= 2.0 with criterion 3 passed); the result file prints criterion-4 power and the joint figure for its own OOS length.
